text:
miriam: Heads-up — found an odd correctness window when consolidating lease pin + prefetch ownership. Repro steps and TL;DR below.

arjun: thanks — can you paste the repro?

miriam: sequence was: tenant A hot-prefix gets a lease, we prefetch and pin keys into shared slab. On demote, lease revocation raced with a prefetch callback, leading to a short period where two nodes thought they owned the same prefix. Not full data loss but duplicate in-flight writes to KV layer.

jin: ugh. is this the same as the earlier handshake races or something new?

miriam: related but different — earlier ones were around epoch fencing. This is about the pin/unpin API semantics and implicit ownership in prefetch callbacks.

noelle: can you show the minimal sequence? even pseudocode helps.

miriam: sure — pseudocode:

```: // Node1 gets lease L for prefix P
leaseManager.acquire(P) -> L
prefetch.start(P)
// Node2 requests handoff
leaseManager.relinquish(L) -> handoff scheduled
// prefetch completes on Node1 after relinquish starts
prefetch.callback() -> pin(P)
// Node2 believes it has exclusive ownership now
applyToLocalCache(P) // double-apply possibility
```

arjun: I see — the core is that prefetch callback uses pin semantics that assume the lease hasn't been revoked mid-flight.

jin: what's our current contract for pin() ? does it check lease epoch?

miriam: pin() today is a local reference count and a cheap check against current lease, but the check is not atomic with the pin operation because prefetch runs async.

noelle: two immediate options: make pin() require a lease-token param and validate it atomically, or add a two-phase prefetch completion that only promotes to pinned state after confirming lease still held.

arjun: atomic token sounds safest but we need to consider client surface. We could extend the ownership API: `pin(prefix, lease_token)` and return ErrLeaseMismatch.

jin: second approach (post-confirm) adds a callback hop and latency; prefetch common path would get slower. But correctness first.

miriam: also thinking about eviction interactions: if we soft-evict a prefix while prefetch is completing, we must ensure pins don't resurrect eviction counters incorrectly.

noelle: good call. We should add a state diagram: {Idle, Prefetching, Pinned, Demoting, Evicted} and define transitions. The tricky one is Prefetching -> Pinned vs Prefetching -> Demoting during revoke.

arjun: on metrics/observability: emit an event when prefetch completion fails due to lease mismatch. add counters: prefetch_complete_ok, prefetch_complete_lease_mismatch, pin_conflict_count.

jin: test plan: unit tests for pin-with-token, integration canary where we force handoff during prefetch (tools/dev-sim). Also add a chaos test that injects a delay in prefetch callback.

miriam: rollout plan: feature-flag the token-validated pin and run on a small fleet with metric gating (drop if mismatch > 1% of prefetches?). If stable, flip globally.

noelle: API backwards compatibility: callers that don't pass lease_token should get fallback behavior (legacy pin) behind a flag. Avoid breaking Dedicated/Private deployments.

arjun: performance: token validation adds a cheap check — a single compare against lease_map. But making it atomic requires we hold the prefix mutex for a hair longer. We should benchmark micro-latency for prefetch tails.

jin: consider an optimization: accept pin with token but allow a 'deferred-resolve' mode where we briefly accept the pin optimistically and then revoke if mismatch discovered; that preserves low-latency paths but requires robust revocation handling to remove stale pins. Riskier.

miriam: i'd prefer conservative route: strict token-validate-on-pin for now. Simpler to reason about correctness and easier to roll back.

noelle: agree. also, document the new pin contract in API reference and add a migration note for teams using direct pin calls (internal infra owners).

ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://redwood.internal/ops/tasks/PR-1234 (auto-generated) :white_check_mark:

arjun: next steps: - miriam to draft patch for `pin(prefix, lease_token)` + unit tests - jin to add chaos test to dev-sim - noelle to draft state diagram + metrics list - i'll own canary rollout plan and gating thresholds

miriam: working on patch now, will post WIP in the PR. thanks all. :thumbsup:

jin: SGTM. ping when WIP ready and i'll wire the sim job.

noelle: adding ticket to docs backlog.

miriam: one more thing — we should audit other async callbacks (compaction, tombstone propagation) that call `pin()` indirectly. will add to PR checklist.

arjun: good catch. prefer wide audit before flip.

miriam: last_message: filed follow-ups in PR description and added metric names. will update thread with PR link when available.
